'''Quen Duo''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]]. He was employed by [[Cobalt Conglomerate]] to help them win a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the wake of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]].<ref name="Game" />
